title: React Styling Core Check
description: Check your understanding of React styling approaches, CSS Modules, styled-components, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, theming, responsive design, and accessibility.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: What is a key benefit of CSS Modules in React?

options.text: They locally scope class names to reduce accidental global collisions
They replace the need for semantic HTML

questions.explanation: CSS Modules generate locally scoped class names while letting you write regular CSS syntax.

questions.prompt: How do inline styles differ from CSS classes in React?

options.text: Inline styles use a JavaScript object and camelCased property names
Inline styles can include media queries directly
Inline styles are written in `.module.css` files
Inline styles always override accessibility rules

questions.explanation: React inline styles use objects such as `style={{ backgroundColor: 'red' }}`. They are best for dynamic one-off values, not full styling systems.

questions.prompt: CSS Modules still allow a deliberate global escape hatch when you need to target global selectors.
questions.explanation: CSS Modules are local by default but can support global selectors when explicitly needed.

questions.prompt: In styled-components, what does styling with props enable?

options.text: Dynamic styles based on component props

questions.explanation: CSS-in-JS libraries like styled-components can derive styles from props, such as a `variant` or `active` value.

questions.prompt: What is Tailwind CSS primarily built around?

options.text: Runtime CSS generated by React state

questions.explanation: Tailwind favors small utility classes such as `p-4`, `text-sm`, and responsive variants like `md:grid-cols-2`.

questions.prompt: Which concerns are part of accessible styling? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Using color as the only indicator of meaning

questions.explanation: Accessible styling includes contrast, focus visibility, responsive readability, and avoiding color-only communication.

questions.prompt: What are design tokens useful for in theming?

options.text: Centralizing values such as colors, spacing, and radii

questions.explanation: Tokens make theme values consistent and easier to change across components and modes.

questions.prompt: What does Bootstrap's grid help with?
questions.explanation: Bootstrap provides layout utilities, including a grid system, that can be used in React markup.
